## Change

## Checks

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:integration` and `pnpm test:e2e` pass

## Privacy

- [ ] No new third party is contacted at runtime
- [ ] No new personal data is collected or stored
- [ ] Nothing is stored on the visitor's device
- [ ] Retention periods are unchanged
- [ ] If any box above is unchecked: the privacy policy generator and README section "What it collects" are updated
